hippocratics-brain-seat-of-mind.description: A bearded older man in a brown draped robe sits in a dim stone room, holding a pale plaster head with an exposed pink brain model on its top, and points at the brain with his other hand. Two younger men in tunics listen intently on the left, one leaning forward on a stone bench. Shelves hold pottery, a rolled scroll and a wooden set square lie on a table at right. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text.

bethlem-hospital-first-patients.description: An oil-style painting of a Gothic stone archway with a heavy studded wooden door swung open on the left. Three men in black hooded cloaks with small white star-like badges stand in a stone cloister passage; the central one steers a gaunt, bewildered man in a ragged pale tunic and rough shoes. A fourth figure stands in the dim background near the door. Stone floor, pointed vaulted ceiling, no visible text.

weyer-witches-mentally-ill.description: An oil-style painting of a bearded older man in a dark fur-collared robe writing with a quill in a large open book by candlelight. Through a leaded window behind him, a crowd gathers in a town square around a pyre or stake. The desk also holds an inkwell, dividers and a magnifier, and the pages show only illegible scribbles. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

mesmer-animal-magnetism.description: A man in a dark coat stands over a reclining woman in a grey gown in a candlelit, gilded room with drapes. His hand rests on her head and his other hand hovers near her shoulder. In the foreground a wooden tub is full of iron rods and rope, and seated people in 18th-century dress hold rods from it. Musicians with a violin and cello stand in the background crowd. No visible text, frame or border.

gall-founds-phrenology.description: A painting of a dim 19th-century room. A man in a dark frock coat and white cravat stands behind a seated, balding older man and presses both hands on his head. Plaster busts with painted grid lines sit on shelves on the left, one skull-like, lit by candles. Spectators in period dress sit in the background beneath anatomical prints. No legible text, no frame, no gore.

phineas-gage-accident.description: A young man with dark hair in a waistcoat and work trousers sits slumped on a rocky ledge, one hand pressed to his chest, with a long pointed iron bar lying across the rocks beside him. Behind him, several men in flat caps and waistcoats stand among shovels and tools in a rocky cutting, with smoke drifting in the background. A wooden barrel sits at the right edge. The style is a painted, realistic 19th-century scene with no visible text.

broca-speech-area.description: An elderly man with grey hair and side whiskers, in a dark coat and bow tie, holds a pinkish human brain in both hands and points one finger at its surface beside a bright window. A younger man in round spectacles and a dark suit stands behind him, holding a notepad and quill. On a wooden table at the lower left are a glass jar, a folded cloth, forceps and scissors. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with 19th-century dress and furnishings. There is no visible text, frame or border, and the painting runs edge to edge.

wundt-leipzig-psychology-lab.description: An oil-painting style scene in a dim, wood-paneled laboratory with shelves of books and glassware. A bearded man in a dark suit and pince-nez leans over a seated young man in a grey waistcoat, both looking at a brass apparatus with two white clock-like dials and wires running to a battery box. The setting suggests the late 19th century. No legible text, no visible frame, and nothing gory.

cajal-neuron-doctrine.description: An older man with a grey-white beard, in a dark suit and apron, sits at a wooden desk drawing a branching, tree-like ink figure on paper with a pen. A brass microscope stands at right beside him. The desk holds glass dishes, slides, ink bottles and pen nibs, and more ink drawings of branching forms lie on sheets at the bottom edge. The background is dark brown and painterly, with a candle-lit, 19th-century studio feel. The painting runs edge to edge. No legible text is visible; the bottle labels are too small to read.

james-principles-of-psychology.description: An older man with a grey beard and dark suit sits at a wooden desk, writing in an open notebook with a pen. Behind him are shelves of leather-bound books, a framed map and small prints on the wall, and a tall window showing bare trees and a rushing river. The desk holds an inkwell, a stack of green-bound books, papers and small brass instruments. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

binet-simon-intelligence-test.description: A painted interior with a dark chalkboard and wood-panelled wall. A man in a dark suit with a beard leans over a small wooden table and works with a boy in a dark smock, who is arranging wooden blocks. Small paper cards with drawings lie on the table. A second bearded man in dark clothes stands behind them, writing on a notepad. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no border.

watson-behaviorist-manifesto.description: A white lab rat sits in a small wire cage on a worn wooden lectern. Behind it, a large chalkboard shows a white chalk maze, and a dark jacket hangs over the lectern's left edge. Papers, a pen, an inkwell and a glass of water sit on the desk. The setting is a dim, old-fashioned lecture hall with tiered wooden benches and arched windows. The image is an oil-style painting that fills the frame, with no visible text, frame or wounds.

little-albert-experiment.description: A dim, cluttered laboratory with a candle, shelves of glassware and scientific apparatus. A man in a waistcoat and shirtsleeves swings a hammer at a steel bar hanging from the ceiling, while a second man stands in shadow behind him. In the foreground a crying, light-haired toddler in a white romper stands on a mattress with arms outstretched, and a small white rat sits on the mattress at lower left. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge with no visible text.

rorschach-inkblot-test.description: An older man in glasses and a dark wool suit holds up a white card with a symmetrical black inkblot, while a younger man in profile, chin resting on his hand, looks at it. They sit in a dim study with bookshelves and stacked papers on a desk, in an oil-painting style.

moniz-first-lobotomy.description: A dim, brownish oil painting of an old operating room. A sheet-draped table sits under a round surgical lamp, with a tray of instruments and a syringe in the foreground. Tiled walls, gowns and a cap hang on hooks. No people, no text, no frame, no blood.

first-electroconvulsive-therapy.description: A dimly lit oil-style painting of a 1930s-looking room. A man in a white coat leans over a black metal box with a dial and cables on a side table. A second man in a white coat stands at the head of a cot, placing a headband or electrode on a reclining patient's head. A woman in a dark dress stands at the right edge. The patient is calm and nothing is bloody. There is no visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the canvas.

maslow-hierarchy-of-needs.description: A dim, warmly lit study with a green banker's lamp on a wooden desk covered in papers, an open book and a cup of coffee. Bookshelves line the left wall, and a leather chair sits empty with a jacket hung over it. On the right stands a large chalkboard in a wooden frame, with a white chalk pyramid drawn in horizontal layers. There are no letters or labels visible, and no people.

cade-lithium-for-mania.description: A guinea pig sits in a small wire cage on a worn wooden bench, lit by a single desk lamp. Behind it, glass Erlenmeyer flasks with clear liquid and a glass syringe rest on a cloth. A white lab coat hangs on a hook at right, and several small wire cages sit on shelves in the dim background, each holding a rodent. The scene is a dark, oil-painted laboratory interior with no people and no visible text.

chlorpromazine-first-antipsychotic.description: An older man with swept-back grey hair and a white lab coat stands in the foreground holding a glass syringe up to the light and looking down at it. Behind him, a nurse in a dark dress and white cap stands by iron-frame hospital beds, and a seated patient in a plain gown sits on one bed. The room has tall arched windows, dark plaster walls and a wooden floor, and the whole scene is a dim, painterly oil style. I see no text, no frame, and nothing graphic.

patient-hm-memory-loss.description: A dim, warmly lit laboratory or study painted in oil style. In the foreground a wooden desk holds a dark wooden box with a tilted mirror, and a sheet of paper with a drawn star outline and a pencil sits in front of it. A black articulated desk lamp is at left, with glass flasks and bottles on shelves behind. At right, a white lab coat hangs over the back of a wooden chair, with a blank clipboard on its seat. Background cabinets and electrical equipment fill the dark corners. No people, no visible text, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.

milgram-obedience-experiment.description: A man in a white shirt and dark tie sits at a grey metal control panel with rows of switches, levers and dials, one hand reaching toward the switches and his face strained. A man in a grey lab coat stands behind him with a hand on his shoulder. The room is dark and plain, with a closed door, a single overhead light, and a tiled wall. The mood is tense and sombre, and the clothing and equipment look mid-twentieth century. No text, numbers or frame are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

kubler-ross-five-stages-grief.description: A dim oil painting of an empty hospital bed with rumpled sheets, a metal bedframe, an IV stand and bag, a drawn curtain, and a bedside cabinet with an articulated desk lamp. A chair in the foreground holds an open notebook and pen. Mid-20th-century hospital cues. No letters, frame, or gore; the painting fills the edge.

stanford-prison-experiment.description: A painting of a dim concrete corridor with a pipe along the ceiling and barred cell doors. Three prisoners in loose light smocks and knit caps stand facing the wall, with chains on their ankles and wrists. On the right, a man in khaki uniform and aviator sunglasses, with a whistle on his chest, holds a wooden baton and looks toward the prisoners. The lighting is low and warm-grey, in a painterly style. There is no visible text, frame or border.

rosenhan-pseudopatients.description: A man in a worn grey-beige shirt and trousers sits on a wooden bench, bent over a small notebook and writing with a pen. Behind him a doctor in a white coat and a nurse in a white uniform and cap move through a dim room with tall windows, and two shadowed figures sit at the left edge. Oil-painting style, no visible text, fills the frame edge to edge; the setting and dress suggest a mid-20th-century institution.

gardner-multiple-intelligences.description: An indoor classroom in oil-paint style, with sunlight through tall windows. A woman with glasses sits in the middle with her hand to her chin, watching. A blond boy plays a violin at left, a boy in a dark shirt and a boy in a patterned shirt work on a tall tower of wooden blocks, a boy in a green shirt reads an open picture book, and a girl in a skirt dances with her arms raised at right. Posters, bookshelves and children's drawings line the walls. No legible text, no frame.

prozac-reaches-market.description: An older man with grey hair in a white lab coat stands behind a dark wooden counter, holding a white pill bottle. A small green-and-white capsule lies on the counter. A dark-sleeved arm reaches in from the left toward the bottle. The background has shelves of amber bottles, a beige CRT monitor with a keyboard, and stacked papers. It is an oil-painting style, cropped edge to edge, with no visible text.

optogenetics-switches-neurons.description: A glowing blue branching neuron with dendrites spreading across a dark painted ground, with a bright light beam coming down from a thin fibre-optic tip above it. Behind it at upper left is a metal microscope, and at right a lab bench with a petri dish, a glass flask, and a panel of dials with wires attached. Dark oil-paint style, no visible text, no frame.
